summary: Add the repository-map contract and deterministic application index
description: Implement the repository-intelligence foundation from .go/plans/repository-intelligence.json: a compact committed semantic repository map plus a provider-free, regenerable detailed graph. Source code remains authoritative, .go is excluded from self-indexing, and existing repositories remain valid without opting in.
acceptance: An optional schema-versioned .go/repository-map.json stores compact stable component nodes, paths, intended dependencies and overlays; repository validation accepts legacy repos without it and strictly validates it when present.

A provider-free index build deterministically enumerates Git-visible source while excluding .go, VCS metadata, dependencies and build output; it records content hashes plus language-neutral file/component/test nodes and Python symbol/import edges in .go/cache/repository-graph.json.

The detailed graph is explicitly derived, local and regenerable: .go/cache ignores generated contents, repeated unchanged builds are byte-stable, and source/architecture/task state remain authoritative.
Public JSON CLI behavior builds, reports status and queries a bounded repository subgraph with exact path/symbol provenance and actionable missing/stale errors.
Behavioral tests prove schema/runtime agreement, deterministic output, exclusions, stale detection, generic and Python extraction, query limits and backward compatibility.
